> 第23章 贪狼族（第1页）
贪狼一族的皇看似威严，其实还是很溺爱自己的孩子的。尤其是怕自己的妻子和父亲。
与其说是怕那其实是爱和孝敬，谁也不会想到贪狼皇是这样一个人。
李天来到虎啸山贪狼一族的族群转眼半年时间过去了。
这一天，李天睁开了眼睛。服侍他的侍女看着醒来的李天，惊喜过望，连忙通知自己的皇，捏碎一块玉佩。
李天醒来看到有人照顾他，还是一个很好看的少女。看着周围陌生的城堡，开口道。
侍女小红回答道，这里是贪狼一族，你救了我们小公子，谢谢你，我叫小红…。
就在这时一道威严的身影走了进来，小红见状站在一边。贪婪王伸手摸了摸李天手臂，运转灵力。贯穿了李天身躯，血色平稳。只是灵力耗尽，导致身体有点虚弱。
男子开口道，谢谢你救了我儿子孩子，狼小飞。你现在好的差不多了，再调养几天可以完全康复。这里是贪狼一族我是这里的狼皇，等你好了设宴招待你。
李天急忙开口，狼皇哪里的话，祸端我引起的，不该往你们的领地跑，差点害了狼皇子。
也不能全怪你，那小子老是偷偷跑出去玩。管不住，跟他说了外面很危险，他就是不听!这次也算是给他一个教训。
不过谢谢你，救了他也是事实。你也不要叫我狼皇，叫我一声叔叔就行。
追杀你的人我也没办法全部击杀。但是大部分已经死了，只跑了一部分。因为外面地界是天武域刘氏皇朝的地界，我们互不侵犯的，贸然出现在他们的地界，会引发族群战争。
听着跑了的那一部分人，李天知道是那几个有天神护道者的公子和皇子。李天也不意外，眼里闪过一丝丝凶狠，这仇一定要报。好了你好好休息，我先走了，这里有小红照顾你，好了以后我为你接宴。
几天后李天全部恢复，修为境界更加凝固，是时候突破修为了。
李天盘膝而坐，开始炼制丹药。这一次炼制的是化神期丹药和血脉丹，把购买的药材全部炼制完，毫无疑问全是极品丹药，足足三十瓶丹药。
李天进入天书，开始吐服，这一次毫无疑问又增加了二十颗丹药。一举跨入化凡后期。力量的增幅，李天相信一拳天神初期轰爆，中期也能一战!。
对于自己实力的肯定李天还是很自信的。肉身的强横使他肉身堪比妖兽，都知道妖兽肉身力量强大。
李天走出房间，看见小红在修剪花草。

嗯，是的，还有别叫我公子，叫我李天即可，我名字叫李天。
那叫你李公子吧……小红俏皮道，我们狼皇说了你好了就可以去他那里。
在小红的带领下李天很快见到前几天那个贪狼狼皇。
这小子就是上次救咱们儿子的人类？一个绝美女子问道。
李天过来坐吧？这里当自己家不要客气。这是我夫人，你可以叫他苏姨。
谢谢苏姨和狼叔；李天很有礼貌的客气道。

> Chapter 23 Greedy Wolf Clan (Page 1)
The emperor of the Greedy Wolf clan looks majestic, but in fact he dotes on his children. Especially afraid of his wife and father.
Rather than saying it was fear, it was actually love and filial piety. No one would have thought that the Greedy Wolf Emperor was such a person.
Half a year has passed since Li Tian came to the Tanlang Clan in Huxiao Mountain.
On this day, Li Tian opened his eyes. The maid who served him looked at Li Tian who woke up and was overjoyed. She quickly informed her emperor to crush a piece of jade pendant.
When Li Tian woke up, he saw someone taking care of him, and she was a very good-looking girl. Looking at the unfamiliar castles around him, he spoke.
The maid Xiao Hong replied, this is the Greedy Wolf clan, you saved our young master, thank you, my name is Xiao Hong...
At this moment, a majestic figure walked in, and Xiaohong stood aside. The Greedy King reached out and touched Li Tian's arm, using his spiritual power. Penetrating through Li Tian's body, the blood color was steady. It's just that the spiritual power is exhausted, causing the body to be a little weak.
The man said, thank you for saving my son, Lang Xiaofei. You are almost healed now, and you will be fully recovered after a few more days of nursing care. This is the Greedy Wolf Clan and I am the Wolf King here. I will host a banquet for you when you are ready.
Li Tian hurriedly spoke, "What do you mean, Wolf Prince? I caused the trouble. I shouldn't have run into your territory and almost killed the Wolf Prince."
It's not all your fault, that kid keeps sneaking out to play. I couldn't help it, so I told him it was dangerous outside, but he wouldn't listen! This time it was a lesson to him.
But thank you, it is true that I saved him. Don't call me Wolf King, just call me uncle.
I can't kill all the people who are chasing you. But most of them were dead and only some of them escaped. Because the outer boundary is the boundary of the Liu Dynasty in the Tianwu Territory, and we do not infringe upon each other, if we appear rashly on their boundary, it will trigger an ethnic war.
Listening to the group of people who ran away, Li Tian knew that they were the young masters and princes who were protected by gods. Li Tian was not surprised, there was a hint of fierceness in his eyes, he must avenge this. Okay, you have a good rest. I'll leave first. Xiaohong will take care of you here. I'll take care of the banquet for you when you're fine.
After a few days, Li Tian fully recovered and his cultivation realm became more solid. It was time to break through his cultivation realm.
Li Tian sat cross-legged and began to refine the elixir. This time, the elixirs of the transformation stage and the bloodline elixirs were refined. After refining all the medicinal materials purchased, there is no doubt that they are all top-quality elixirs, with a total of thirty bottles of elixirs.
Li Tian entered the Heavenly Book and began to vomit and take it. This time, he undoubtedly added twenty more pills. In one fell swoop, he entered the late stage of mortal transformation. With the increase in power, Li Tian believes that the one-punch god can explode in the early stage and can also fight in the mid-term!.
Li Tian is still very confident in his own strength. The tyranny of his physical body makes his physical body comparable to that of a monster. Everyone knows that a monster's physical body is powerful.
Li Tian walked out of the room and saw Xiaohong pruning flowers and plants.
Well, yes, don’t call me Young Master, just call me Li Tian. My name is Li Tian.
Then call you Mr. Li... Xiaohong said playfully, our Wolf King said you can go to him when you are ready.
Under the leadership of Xiao Hong, Li Tian quickly met the greedy Wolf Emperor a few days ago.
Is this guy the human who saved our son last time? asked a stunningly beautiful woman.
Li Tian, ​​please come and sit down, please? Don't be polite if you treat this place as your own home. This is my wife, you can call her Aunt Su.
Thank you Aunt Su and Uncle Lang; Li Tian said politely.
